finding.claim: The unauthenticated route /invoice/<inv_id> returns any invoice record, including its customer field, to any caller. No ownership check is made, unlike the sibling /my/invoice/<inv_id> route.
finding.source: The inv_id path segment in GET /invoice/<inv_id>, supplied by any unauthenticated client (invoices.py:7-8).
finding.sink: INVOICES.get(inv_id) followed by jsonify(inv) returns the full invoice record (invoices.py:9-10).

trace.note: Route registered with no auth decorator or before_request hook.
inv_id is read from the URL path.
INVOICES.get(inv_id) returns any record. abort(404) only fires when the ID is missing.
jsonify(inv) returns the whole record, including the customer field, with no ownership comparison.
Contrast: /my/invoice/<inv_id> enforces inv['customer'] != g.user['id'] and aborts 404, so the unguarded route looks like an omitted check.

finding.guards_checked: No before_request hook, no login_required-style decorator, and no ownership comparison exist in invoices.py (confirmed by grep for g.user, before_request, login_required). The only conditional is the existence check at line 9. Caveat: a reverse proxy or middleware outside this repository could enforce authentication on /invoice/*, and the repo does not show that. Exploitability also depends on whether invoice IDs are guessable or enumerable, which the repo does not show either.

verdict.guard_found: none. The only guard in the repo is the existence check at invoices.py:9 (`or abort(404)`), which does not test ownership. The route at invoices.py:7 has no auth decorator, and a grep of the repo finds no before_request hook or login_required. The sibling /my/invoice route at invoices.py:16-17 does check ownership and reads g.user, which is never set in this repo.
verdict.reason: The trace matches the code: invoices.py:7 registers the route with no auth, and invoices.py:9-10 returns the full record from INVOICES.get(inv_id) with no ownership check, so an anonymous caller can reach it. The caveat is that g.user at invoices.py:16 is populated outside this repo, so an app-wide auth layer covering /invoice/* would refute the finding, but the repo shows no such layer.
